verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a job-board feed mechanism (XML feed generated per job board, published jobs visible in feed) which supports multi-board distribution, but there is no evidence of specific integrations with LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregators by name or of sponsored-post/paid-ad budget management inside the ATS. Missing for 10: named board integrations (LinkedIn, Indeed), sponsored/paid post management UI, budget tracking, or aggregator marketplace evidence.
